C-SEARCH-RESULT-CONTRACT.Summary: Make the search-result contract real on the whole path: the backend carries honest first-submatch match bounds on SearchHit, the window shim translates them into the single array-pair range form the result component already reads (the fabricated end column goes away), quick open consumes string pathnames again, and the project-search overlay becomes keyboard-operable end to end — Enter from the query input into the results, arrow-key roving, Enter on a match line opens the file at that match — closing the Wave-3 acceptance criterion «с клавиатуры открывается нужный файл на нужном совпадении» (the right file opens at the right match from the keyboard).
C-SEARCH-RESULT-CONTRACT.Problem: Confirmed against the current read-only state of the green-search1 worktree (branch spec/search-result-contract, base bb68fd6c); source findings are WAVE3-SCOUT-SEARCH keys SEARCH-KB-OPEN (1), SEARCH-RANGE-SHAPE (2) and the shape defect recorded under key 6 (2026-11-22). The v1 result contract — string pathnames, range pairs indexed as [row, col], honest match boundaries — is reproduced by no producer and pinned by no integration test. Backend: src-tauri/src/m013b/search.rs SearchHit carries only "pub struct SearchHit { path, line, column, snippet, truncated }"; both engines drop the match end. The rg leg parses just the first submatch start under the comment "// First submatch's start column for the column field. Renderer" / "shim re-derives a range from snippet for highlighting." and leaves "let _ = pattern_len; // reserved for future range-end calc" as a TODO; the embedded walker iterates "matcher.find_iter(&line)" and discards the match end; even the start convention diverges — the walker pushes "column: (m.start() + 1) as u32" while the rg leg stores the raw 0-based submatch start, so the same match highlights one character late on the walker leg and correctly on the rg leg. Shim versus component: src/renderer/src/_shims/install-window-globals.js regroups hits per path and emits object rows, "range: [{ row, column }, { row, column }]" with a fabricated end "(h.column || 0) + (h.snippet ? h.snippet.length : 0)" — a highlight that runs to the end of the line instead of stopping at the match — while src/renderer/src/components/sideBar/searchResultItem.vue reads ARRAY PAIRS: "searchMatch.lineText.substring(0, searchMatch.range[0][1])", "searchMatch.lineText.substring(searchMatch.range[0][1], searchMatch.range[1][1])", and the cursor "anchor: { line: range[0][0], ch: range[0][1] }" / "focus: { line: range[1][0], ch: range[1][1] }" (handleSearchResultClick; substring reads at :36-41, cursor at :150-160). With objects every index is undefined: substring(0, undefined) and substring(undefined, undefined) both behave as substring(0), so all three rendered spans (prefix, "highlight", suffix) show the same full line, and mt::open-file receives cursor "line: undefined, ch: undefined". The component test pins the array form on its own fixture ("range: [[1, 6], [1, 11]]", tests/renderer/components/sideBar/searchResultItem.test.js) and the shim is tested only for boot order (tests/renderer/_shims/install-window-globals.test.js, the C-52 pins) — the producer/consumer mismatch is invisible to every existing test. Quick open: the same shim branch delivers didMatch the grouped envelope of "filePath" plus "matches", but src/renderer/src/commands/quickOpen.js pushes it raw ("didMatch: (result) => { if (canceled) return; searchResult.push(result) }") and later maps "searchResult.map((pathname) => { const item = { id: pathname }" plus "_getPath(pathname)", so id becomes an object; window.fileUtils.isChildOfDirectory returns false for non-strings ("if (typeof parent !== 'string' || typeof child !== 'string') return false"), and executeSubcommand sends that object to mt::open-file-by-window-id — disk results render garbage titles and cannot be opened at all. Keyboard: src/renderer/src/components/projectSearch/index.vue binds @keydown.enter to focusResults while "focusResults" is a documented placeholder ("// Enter in input — no-op for now, results are below"); result rows are click-only — the match line carries only @click="handleSearchResultClick(searchMatch)" in searchResultItem.vue — with no tabindex and no keydown, so Tab and Enter never reach a result and the only keyboard exit is Escape on the input closing the overlay. Net effect: every match highlight is false or broken, every keyboard-opened cursor is undefined, and no quick-open disk result can be opened.
C-SEARCH-RESULT-CONTRACT.Relationship: Direct successor of C-SEARCH-SESSION-COMPLETION (merged as #289) and C-SEARCH-ERROR-VISIBILITY (merged as #303, status applied), both live in the same files: #289's SearchSessionCoordinator keeps sole ownership of the session-wide seq and the single terminal and is untouched; #303's honest error/partial voice, its additive-optional-field wire pattern (skip_serializing_if absent-field preservation) and its renderer suites are reused, not weakened — this change only fills the already-streamed hits with honest match bounds and makes them reachable. The window shim's mt::search-event translation branch stays the single translation funnel. store/search.js is read-only here (the grouped "filePath" plus "matches" renderer envelope is unchanged), as are node/ripgrepSearcher.js (thenable/cancel contract) and node/fileSearcher.js. Sibling bundles from the same scout are recorded as NonGoals and kept separable: C-SEARCH-LIFECYCLE-DISCARD (stale answers and dead limits), C-QUICKOPEN-FILES-MODE (files mode still spawns a content search — this change pins only the shape flowing through today's events), C-SEARCH-ENGINE-PARITY (case, gitignore, UTF-8, tree cost). Related debt, recorded but not absorbed: the walker byte-slice truncation panic ("&line[..MAX_LINE_BYTES]") belongs to the parity bundle; the bounds delivered here must stay defined and free of false highlights regardless of it. Delivered through the repository technical-debt lane; lane departure into main and train accounting are separate owner-controlled steps.

Goals.Goal: Honest match bounds end to end. SearchHit grows additive optional match-bound fields (first-submatch start and end within the delivered line), filled by both engines from their exact spans — the rg leg from the --json submatch start and end, the embedded walker from the regex match span — under one documented unit and base convention defined once and identical for both engines, serialized so that unavailability stays an absent field. The shim maps present bounds into the single array-pair form "[[row, col], [row, col]]" the component reads today, such that the highlighted substring of lineText equals the matched text; the fabricated end "(h.column || 0) + (h.snippet ? h.snippet.length : 0)" is removed. When bounds are unavailable — including a match not fully inside a truncated delivered snippet — the hit is delivered without bounds and the UI renders the line with no highlight and a defined cursor (line start): never a false highlight span, never undefined coordinates.

The project-search overlay is keyboard-operable: Enter in the query input moves focus into the results (the focusResults placeholder becomes this real entry); ArrowUp/ArrowDown move a visible selection across match lines and file results following the zone canon of components/commandPalette/index.vue — a selected index plus an active class plus scrollIntoView, no new ARIA roles (the palette is the zone norm and stays untouched); Enter on a selected match line opens the file at that match through the same code path as click, with the cursor derived from the honest bounds; Escape closes the overlay from both the input and the results; Tab can reach the result rows (rows become focusable or roving-focused per the plan's documented choice).

Quick open's result ids are string pathnames again: the didMatch consumer normalizes the shim's grouped envelope (accepting a plain string too) so "const item = { id: pathname }" builds a string id, isChildOfDirectory and _getPath keep their string contracts, and executeSubcommand sends a string pathname to mt::open-file-by-window-id, making disk-result selection open the file again. The normalization lives where the envelope is consumed; the shim gains no per-searchId mode state.

Failing-first tests pin the contract once per seam: a shim-mapping test on a realistic mt::search-event feed (range form, honest bounds, absence case, per-path grouping, searchId forwarding), a component keyboard test (mounted projectSearch keydown chain through open-at-match), a quickOpen shape test on the shim-shaped feed, backend serialization and span tests (absent-field wire form, walker and rg bounds parity on one fixture, truncated-beyond-bounds absence), and one e2e spec through the tauri-shim fixture proving the Wave-3 criterion — the right file opens at the right match from the keyboard.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep the existing command names (mt_search_spawn, mt_search_cancel), the mt::search-event channel, searchId, kind values (match/complete/cancelled/error), the SearchEvent envelope (hits/error/partial/seq), batch size, per-line cap, M-010 root validation, engine selection (App Store in-process, missing-rg fallback with BLOCK_RIPGREP_FALLBACK) and ordinary root traversal order. SearchHit grows only additive optional match-bound fields with absent-field serialization consistent with the struct's established style; no new event kind, channel or envelope field; the partial-flag semantics delivered by #303 are untouched.

One canonical consumer-side range form: array pairs "[[row, col], [row, col]]" remain the single form at the component boundary (tests/renderer/components/sideBar/searchResultItem.test.js pins "range: [[1, 6], [1, 11]]" and stays green unchanged); the window shim remains the single translation funnel; after this change no producer emits object range rows. The bounds unit and base convention are documented once, shared by both engines, and parity-verified on at least one ASCII and one multi-byte fixture; if offset delivery breaks substring equality against lineText on the multi-byte fixture, the plan either converts to character indices at the backend or documents the ASCII-bounded honesty limitation explicitly — it may not silently ship a known-false span.

Honest-or-absent bounds: bounds refer to the delivered snippet text; a match not fully inside the delivered snippet yields absent bounds; absence renders the line without any highlight and places the cursor at a defined position (line start); the fabricated "column + snippet.length" end is removed everywhere. The opened cursor always derives from the same bounds as the highlight — no separately computed positions.

The keyboard contract follows the zone canon: roving selection as a selected index plus an active class plus scrollIntoView, exactly the commandPalette pattern; no ARIA role additions and no changes to components/commandPalette/index.vue; Enter-on-line and click share one open-at-match code path (mt::open-file with the cursor object); the existing Escape-on-input close is preserved and extended to the results context.

The quick-open fix stays consumer-side (normalize the grouped envelope where didMatch receives it); the shim gains no per-searchId mode map and the backend files-mode semantics ("let _ = mode;") are untouched — the fix is verified against today's content-spawn envelope so it keeps working unchanged when C-QUICKOPEN-FILES-MODE lands.

No new user-facing strings are anticipated (roving selection is visual; no copy changes). If the plan introduces any user-visible string, it lands under the established namespace in all ten locale files (en, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh-CN, zh-TW) following the C-62 all-locales pattern and is gated by the locale-keys test.

ObservedWriteScope (exact, verified present in the current tree): src-tauri/src/m013b/search.rs (SearchHit additive optional match-bound fields, both engine span fills, truncated-bounds absence rule, inline #[cfg(test)] tests); src/renderer/src/_shims/install-window-globals.js (mt::search-event translation branch only — honest range form; the C-52 boot-order pins stay green, so a mapping-test seam must avoid new static imports: extraction into a helper module or mocked Tauri globals, plan's choice, documented); src/renderer/src/components/projectSearch/index.vue (real focusResults, roving selection, Escape handling); src/renderer/src/components/sideBar/searchResultItem.vue (row focusability and keyboard activation of the existing open-at-match path); src/renderer/src/commands/quickOpen.js (didMatch normalization only); tests: tests/renderer/_shims/install-window-globals.test.js or a new sibling mapping test, tests/renderer/components/sideBar/searchResultItem.test.js (cursor pins added, array-form pins unchanged), tests/renderer/components/projectSearch/index.test.js (keyboard chain), tests/renderer/commands/quickOpen.test.js and tests/renderer/commands/quickOpen-deep.test.js (string-id pins on the shim-shaped feed), tests/e2e/fixtures/tauri-shim.ts (additive quiet-by-default mt_search_spawn/mt_search_cancel doubles plus a search-event emit helper for specs), tests/e2e/project-search.spec.ts (new); .grace/graph/runtime.xml (M-004 and M-011 module maps and file-local contracts — M-004's SearchHit output type gains the bounds fields); .grace/verification/runtime.xml (V-M-004 and V-M-011 entries). Read-only anchors: src/renderer/src/store/search.js, src/renderer/src/node/ripgrepSearcher.js, src/renderer/src/node/fileSearcher.js, src/renderer/src/components/commandPalette/index.vue, src/renderer/src/ipc/runtime/search.ts (dead typed facade stays read-only), src/renderer/src/components/search/index.vue (in-document find bar).

Predecessor semantics are not weakened: #289's coordinator terminal ownership, seq discipline and session-trace suites, and #303's error/partial voice, size/exclusion application and their renderer suites all stay green with unchanged assertions and budgets.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No C-SEARCH-LIFECYCLE-DISCARD work: the empty-keyword and cancel generation hole in store/search.js, the dead didSearchPaths limits (100 in the store, 30 in quickOpen), the command-palette query-identity stale flash, the muya image-selector keyup race and the folder-close listener race stay out — they are the sibling bundle from the same scout.

No C-QUICKOPEN-FILES-MODE work: no backend files-mode implementation, no wiring of the dead #[allow(dead_code)] inclusions field, no body-read instrumentation or fixture, no revival of the ">30 files" self-limit; only the result shape that flows through today's events is fixed here.

No C-SEARCH-ENGINE-PARITY work: no smart-case or gitignore-outside alignment, no UTF-8 byte-slice truncation fix, no tree-emit batching, no engine unification, no rg sidecar bundling; no search ranking, regex syntax changes, context-line delivery or new search features.

No redesign of the command-palette UX, no changes to the typed ipcSearch facade, no quick-open debounce or cancellation rework beyond the consumer-side envelope normalization, no editor find-bar changes, no preferences storage or schema changes, no dependency acquisition, release version, tags or publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Failing-first backend tests pin the additive bounds: a serialization test proves the wire form keeps absent-field serialization when bounds are unavailable and carries both values when known; one fixture searched by both engines (walker always, rg availability-guarded) yields identical bounds semantics; a truncated snippet whose match lies beyond the delivered text yields absent bounds. Existing search suites stay green.

A shim-mapping test on a realistic mt::search-event feed (matches across two paths, a multi-match line, a bounds-absent hit) proves every delivered match carries range as array pairs with honest bounds — the highlighted substring of lineText equals the matched text — the bounds-absent hit maps to the no-highlight, defined-cursor form, per-path grouping and searchId forwarding are unchanged, and the fabricated "column + snippet.length" end no longer exists. The test fails against today's shim before the fix.

Component tests pin open-at-match: activating a match line (click and keyboard) invokes mt::open-file with the cursor anchor "ch" equal to the honest start and focus "ch" equal to the honest end on the fixture row — never undefined — while the existing array-form fixture pins ("range: [[1, 6], [1, 11]]") pass unchanged.

A mounted-projectSearch component test drives the keydown chain failing-first: Enter in the input moves focus into the results; ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the visible selection across match lines (active class per the commandPalette canon); Enter on a selected line opens that file at that match; Escape closes the overlay from both the input and the results. Today Enter is a no-op and the rows are unreachable, so every step of this chain is red before the fix.

With the searcher mocked to deliver the shim-shaped "filePath" plus "matches" envelope, quickOpen resolves a list whose ids are pathname strings, _getPath receives strings, and executeSubcommand sends mt::open-file-by-window-id with the string pathname; the existing tabs-only and no-root suites stay green. Fails today because id becomes an object.

A new e2e spec through tests/e2e/fixtures/tauri-shim.ts (additive quiet-by-default search doubles) boots the editor, opens the project-search overlay, submits a query whose fixture envelope carries honest bounds, and proves the Wave-3 criterion from the keyboard: Enter/Tab from the input into the results, arrows to the fixture match line, Enter — the fixture file opens (mt::open-new-tab through the existing mt_open_file double) carrying the cursor at the fixture match position.

Graph ownership, module maps and verification entries (M-004, M-011, V-M-004, V-M-011) describe the final contract — M-013 stays a read-only adjacency (its stub records name the facade and commands; no M-013 file is edited); all pre-existing suites — the #289 session-trace family, the #303 store/overlay/error family, searchResultItem, the quickOpen unit suites, the shim C-52 boot-order pins and the e2e search-bar spec — pass without weakened assertions or budgets.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Named new tests pin the behaviors: search-hit-bounds-wire-form (absent-field serialization, present values), bounds-parity-across-engines (one fixture, walker and rg, identical semantics, truncated-beyond-bounds absence), shim-range-array-form (honest bounds, highlight substring equals the match, absence case, per-path grouping, fake end removed), project-search-keyboard-chain (Enter into results, arrow roving, Enter opens at match, Escape closes), quickopen-string-ids (shim-shaped feed, string id, string open invocation), plus the e2e keyboard-open receipt through the tauri-shim search doubles. Existing #289 session-trace, #303 honest-state, searchResultItem, quickOpen and C-52 boot-order receipts are preserved as pre-change evidence, not relabeled.

rg-leg behaviors are guarded by the existing availability checks; the walker leg is exercised in-process; the App Store and missing-rg fallback paths stay untouched and covered by the existing walker suites. Unavailable platform or owner acceptance evidence remains explicitly open and is not substituted by a shim.

Assumptions.Assumption: The component stays the array-pair consumer; migrating consumers to object ranges was considered and rejected — tests/renderer/components/sideBar/searchResultItem.test.js already pins the array form, every downstream reader (highlight spans and the open cursor) uses it, and the shim is a single translation funnel, so producer-side honesty plus a faithful shim translation is the smallest honest fix. Reversing this decision would put the component, its tests and the store fixtures on the migration path for no behavior gain.

Match bounds are defined against the delivered snippet text in a unit the plan documents and parity-verifies; the plan checks a multi-byte fixture once on the delivery baseline and either delivers character-exact indices or documents the ASCII-bounded limitation in this change's record. The walker byte-slice truncation panic itself belongs to C-SEARCH-ENGINE-PARITY and is not fixed here.

The quick-open shape fix is verified against today's files-mode behavior (a content spawn with an empty pattern, where the backend still reads bodies — the exact defect C-QUICKOPEN-FILES-MODE owns); when that bundle changes the engine leg, the shape pins rerun unchanged on that baseline.
Approval of this specification does not approve an unwritten plan, apply/archive, lane departure or release.
